summary.headline: Planetary Oppositions and Natal Effects
summary.text: Astrological delineations of planetary oppositions: Jupiter opposed to Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury, and Moon, followed by Mars opposed to the Sun and Venus, with effects on character, wealth, kinship, marriage, legal affairs, death, and danger. The passage also distinguishes effects by fixation, ingresses, lunar light, diurnal or nocturnal nativity, and tropical signs.
